description: One Tron transaction by txid: success or reverted, energy used, the call it made, and - this is the important part - any TRC-20 transfers decoded from the receipt logs (token, from, to, amount). When to use: did this USDT payment really land, for how much, from whom, and is it finalized. Do not use: for address risk scoring (tron_check_address_risk) or for blocks (tron_get_block). Boundary: our node is a lite full node with a recent window (~6 days); an empty result means 'outside our window', NOT 'the payment did not arrive' - fall back to an indexer before saying a payment is missing. Returns: found, block_number, status, contract_type, owner/to/contract_address, amount_trx, trc20_transfers[], energy_used, confirmations, finalized, retention_window.
name: tron_get_transaction
title: Tron Get Transaction
